research_rules.entry: FIRST distinct signal-timeframe EMA20 touch after confirmed opposite ST flip
research_rules.volume_filter: previous completed 15M volume > 1.2 times its 20-candle SMA
research_rules.volatility_filter: previous completed 15M Wilder ATR14 > 20-candle SMA of ATR14
research_rules.first_touch_filter_failure: reject entire current ST direction cycle, no second-touch substitute
research_rules.atr_smoothing: Wilder RMA seeded at SMA of first 10 true ranges
research_rules.supertrend_line_reference: diagnostic only; risk distance is NOT an entry gate without TP
research_rules.initial_trailing_stop: entry +/- multiplier * ATR14 from last fully closed 15M bar
research_rules.trailing_atr14_distance: FIXED at entry, multiplier 2 or 3 x prior closed 15M Wilder ATR14
research_rules.trailing_monitoring: 1m chronological hypothetical OHLC path; on favorable move ratchet stop by same distance; stop never retreats
research_rules.stop_loss: FIRST of ATR14 trailing stop breach on 1m path or opposite confirmed 15M Supertrend flip at next 15M open
research_rules.trade_reentry: max one entry per ST regime
